title: Live smoke: a chief delegates one micro-task and reports the settled result
behavior: Against a real model, a chief still routes one concrete task through exactly one coordinate_bots call to the Engineering maker, the maker replies in its own node thread, and both handoff nodes complete.

steps.text: Use coordinate_bots as your only tool call to assign the Engineering maker one micro-task: reply with the single word READY. When the maker completes, reply here with one short confirmation sentence. Do not do the micro-task yourself.
